Aisha: Scheduling a BYOK-safe sim next Tue 09:30 PT. Purpose: validate detection when an operator attempts to export a tenant-scoped wrapping key via our KMS-proxy -> HSM flow. Need quick checks: RBAC delta, audit captures, and minimal IR steps.

Rafael: Keep RBAC tiny: create ephemeral role with `kms:GenerateWrappedKey` for one synthetic key only, TTL 1h, bound to service account. No wildcard resources.

Nina: Logging: enable debug KMS proxy logs and set retention to 90d for this run. Tag requests with `sim=true`. HSM: capture operator-id, command, and signature fields.

Doug: Compliance items: pre-approval ticket in JIRA with Security + Legal sign-off. Notify BYOK customers with opt-out window. Post-sim signed artifacts: IAM change log, HSM audit dump, proxy logs, pcap, and signed report.

Aisha: Sample minimal policy (will add exact timestamp condition in JIRA): `{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateWrappedKey"],"Resource":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/tenantX/cryptoKeys/synth-key"}`. Also require `kms:RequestTag/sim=true`.

Rafael: IR playbook: if anything unexpected, revoke the ephemeral role immediately, rotate only the synthetic canary key, and notify `#incidents`. Avoid touching real customer keys.

Nina: I'll produce a runbook fragment with queries to pull: `protoPayload.methodName:("GenerateWrappedKey" OR "ImportKeyMaterial")`, proxy request tags, and HSM operator entries. Post by EOD.

sim-bot: Reminder: maintenance window Tue 09:00-10:30 PT. Pager escalation enabled for sim. Use `#incidents` for real alerts.

Aisha: Thanks all 64f I'll open the JIRA and attach RBAC snippet.
summary: BYOK-safe tenant sim planning: RBAC, audit evidence, and IR checklist
